OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
PALOS VERDES ESTATES, CALIFORNIA 90274
Copies of the staff reports or other written documentation relating to each item of business referred to on the agenda are on file in the office of the City Clerk and are available for public inspection. If applicable, materials related to an item on this agenda submitted to the Council after distribution of the agenda packet are available for public inspection in the City Clerk's office during normal business hours. Any person having any question concerning any agenda item may call the City Clerk to make inquiry concerning the item. Upon request, the agenda and documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. Please contact the City Clerk at 310-378-0383, at least 48 hours prior to the meeting to request a disability-related modification or accommodation.
The City Council welcomes and encourages public participation at the Council meetings; however, to allow for the orderly progression of business, each person wishing to comment or make a presentation shall be limited to up to three (3) minutes. Anyone wishing to address the City Council is requested to fill out a green speaker's card available at the entry of the meeting room. The card permits the City to identify persons for purposes of City Council minute preparation. Please see specific agenda sections below for any other requirements related to meeting participation. The City Council, at the direction of the Mayor with concurrence of the Council, may modify the order of items shown on the agenda.

PC-CTP-05-16; Minor Planting Plan application for George Allen Field to grade a level area under the pine tree to provide a shaded seating area, install bat racks and storage shelves and mount a fence guard on the chain-link fence.

1544 Via Zurita

M-1076-16; Consideration of a Miscellaneous Application for a new detached structure exceeding the allowable height at the single family residence located at 3657 Navajo Place. Applicant: Russ Barto
3 Malaga Cove Plaza, #202
Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274
Owner: Adam & Stephanie Felenstein
Action: Approved (5-0 in favor) with standard conditions and the following additional conditions: 1) The depth of the second story master bedroom deck shall be revised to be 5 ft.; 2) Landscaping shall be provided along the rear property line to provide a visual barrier between the subject property and the property to the rear at 4009 Via Gavilan. A landscape plan shall be submitted and reviewed and approved by the Planning Director.
d.
WT-135-15; Wireless Telecommunication Facilities Application for new equipment within the City right-of-way across from 1428 Paseo La Cresta.
Applicant: Crown Castle NG West LLC
300 Spectrum Center Dr., #1200
Irvine, CA 92618
Action: Approved (5-0 in favor) with standard conditions and the following additional conditions: 1) The steel pole shall be burnished prior to painting. The pole and antennas must be painted a flat dark brown, and maintained in the same condition thereafter; 2) All cables interconnecting the antennas and all transmission equipment should run within the replacement pole except as minimally required to connect to the antennas; 3) The equipment cabinet should be painted a color to blend in with the existing surrounding environment and nearby meter cabinet in the PROW; 4) The replacement steel pole is not a wireless tower for any purpose, but rather it is considered only a replacement City street sign pole; 5) The steel pole shall be designated as a replacement for the existing pole to be removed, and after installation, the replacement pole shall be dedicated to the City for a fee of $1.00 so that it is clear for federal law purposes that replacement pole maintain its primary use and function as a City traffic sign support; 6) Permittee shall install and at all times maintain in good condition an â€œRF Noticeâ€ and â€œNetwork Operations Center Informationâ€ sign on the steel pole at approximately 14 feet AGL; 7) Permittee shall ensure that all RF signage complies with FCC OET Bulletin 65 or ANSI C95.2 for color, symbol, and content conventions; 8) Attached one way sign shall be installed in accordance with the MUTCD (Manual Uniform Traffic Control Devices) California Edition; and 9) Attached one way sign shall be with approved hardware per the Cityâ€™s Maintenance Foreman.
e.
NC-1547/G-1562/M-1077-15; Consideration of Neighborhood Compatibility, Grading & Miscellaneous Applications for a new single family residence located at 941 Via Nogales. Lot 1, Block 1633, Tract 7330. This project is exempt from CEQA pursuant to California Administrative Code Title 14, Chapter 3, Section 15303.
Applicant: Tomaro Architecture
2617 N. Sepulveda Blvd., #100
Manhattan Beach, CA 90266
Owner: Chowdhury Homes LLC
32040 Cape Point Dr.
Rancho Palos Verdes, CA 90275
Action: Approved (5-0 in favor) with standard conditions and the following additional conditions: 1) Portions of the lot being graded/excavated exceed 25% grade; thus, the project shall comply with the Cityâ€™s municipal NPDES permit and requirements set forth in Municipal Code 13.08.060, Section C; 2) A license agreement shall be submitted to defend, indemnify, and hold harmless the city, its officers, agents and employees from and against any and all loss, damage, liability, claims, demands, costs, charges, and expenses, including attorneyâ€™s fees, and causes of action of whatsoever character which the City may incur, sustain or be subjected to on account of loss or damage to property or loss of use thereof, or for bodily injury to or death of any person arising out of or in any way connected to the encroachment, 3) A license agreement shall be submitted to reimburse the City for any costs incurred by the City to repair damage, restore premises, or satisfy claims incurred by reason of the encroachment; and 4) All non-standard encroachments and overgrown vegetation shall be removed including, but not limited to, the east-west block wall that blocks access to the right-of-way and the shed, within the City right-of-way.
f.
Proposed Amendment to Section 18.12.030, and proposed addition of Chapter 18.73 and Sections 18.04.021, 18.08.012, 18.16.060, and 18.37.050, to the Palos Verdes Estates Municipal Code in order to impose an express ban on marijuana cultivation, delivery and dispensaries with the City.
Action: Planning Commission opened the public hearing, closed the public hearing and adopted Planning Commission Resolution No. 2016-0898 (5-0 in favor) recommending the City Council approve Ordinance No. 16-716, with an added condition that following adoption of the Ordinance, this item be brought back at a future date to the Planning Commission for additional evaluation regarding restricting cannabis delivery and restricting qualified patients or primary caregivers cultivating cannabis.
